description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) CALISTUS ka'tah through the real unit_selected_to_move window (WP-C3). Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes, round 2): loading the Command-phase save runs the Martial Ka'tah readied step, then the scenario moves to the Movement phase. Witchseekers C stand right behind the friendly Telemon Heavy Dreadnought (a VEHICLE: models cannot normally move across it). (1) A real click on the Witchseekers selects them to move: the stratagem window opens with a 0-CP KA'TAH card CALISTUS whose 'Use on Witchseeker Squad' button is enabled. (2) A real click on Use spends no CP, un-readies the unit (gold K badge gone) and sets the Calistus effect. (3) Ctrl+A group-drags the squad 5.75" north STRAIGHT THROUGH the Telemon; the drop is accepted (it would be refused without Calistus — the B case is pinned headless in test_custodes_army_rules_11e.gd D1) and End This Unit's Move locks it in. (4) Ending the Movement phase offers SUPERHUMAN FOCUS (Guardians of the Throne phase_end card — the Witchseekers are no longer readied, WP-C5), which a real click declines; the phase ends and Calistus is cleared (phase-scoped).

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var focus := Vector2(320.0, 1640.0)
var z := 1.6
var vp: Vector2 = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
m.camera.position = focus
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(z, z)
m.view_zoom = z
m.view_offset = focus - vp / (2.0 * z)
m.update_view_transform()
return true

steps.comment: every Witchseekers C token shows the readied marker
the window re-opens with the remaining stratagem offers (if any) — none of them is under test
every model staged north of the Telemon (its north edge is y 40.0" = 1600 px)

WP-FIX1: the Witchseekers spent their readied state on CALISTUS, so the WP-C5 SUPERHUMAN FOCUS (Guardians of the Throne, END OF ANY PHASE, target a NOT readied unit) phase_end card is correctly offered — not under test
offered for the unit that is no longer readied
real click: decline SUPERHUMAN FOCUS (not under test)
Calistus lasts for the phase it was used in
